propositions: bridge fsck lacks an on-demand, non-blocking way for operators to verify that mapped project keys and legacy_default are currently visible to the bot
add an opt-in --live-visibility flag to bridge fsck that performs a read-only, advisory live visibility check without mutating bridge state or changing exit contract
the visibility check must reuse the shared helper from access_check.py (check_mapped_project_visibility) to avoid duplicating existence-check logic

when Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected, the fsck step must gracefully skip with a skipped/missing_credentials verdict instead of failing
the advisory verdict must be rendered to stderr in both text and JSON output modes without altering the stdout JSON schema contract
core rebar doctor must remain Jira-free with no reconciler or agents optional-extra imports reachable from it
